hypothesis: Because official multitask TD-MPC2 pads lower-dimensional legal actions into a shared action vector, a legitimate low-dimensional contributor might alter a victim task's unvisited action directions while preserving its on-trajectory one-step predictions.
operation: Native task-labeled dynamics-only adaptation on 300 real reacher-easy transitions, with the four unused action coordinates exactly zero; 40 upstream three-step consistency updates per source arm.
invariants: unused source action coordinates exactly zero
existing native MPC evaluation on walker-walk
gpu_work: Short CUDA dynamics-only adaptation: 120 updates total, about 22 seconds; no long training.
novelty_status: No accepted claim. Both action groups changed slightly in the same direction, and native walker return stayed near 972; this does not isolate a padded-dimension security effect from ordinary shared-dynamics adaptation.
decision_cn: 低维 reacher 的合法补零经验没有选择性压低 walker 的未访问动作方向：MPC 源使高维动作敏感度变化 0.34%，低维动作变化 0.44%；随机源分别变化 1.85% 与 1.52%。walker 一步潜空间误差比值为 1.026 和 1.141，已有原生回报为 972.30 和 973.75（洁净 972.41）。因此该候选没有通过选择性不变量和任务损害门槛，退役，不扩大 GPU。
